scripts.build-gtk: npm run build-node-network && cargo build -p nodeinnet-gtk --release --target-dir ./bin/gtk-app
scripts.build-wasm-node: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cd ./src/wasm-node && wasm-pack build --target bundler
scripts.run-android-dev: ./src/gtk-app/android/build.sh dev && cd ./src/gtk-app/android && ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}" JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/android-studio/jbr}" ./gradlew :app:installRelease && "${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}/platform-tools/adb" shell am start -n net.nodeinnet.gtk/.MainActivity
scripts.unit-tests: cargo test -p app-core -p app-net -p app-headless -p fm-core -p common -p client-config
scripts.build-gtk-deb: npm run build-gtk && cargo deb -p nodeinnet-gtk
scripts.build-gtk-rpm: npm run build-gtk && cd ./src/gtk-app && cargo generate-rpm --target-dir ../../bin/gtk-app
scripts.build-distr-osx: npm run build-node-network && cd ./src/gtk-app && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=../../bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin cargo bundle --release && cd ../../bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin && mkdir -p ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas && cp $(brew --prefix)/share/glib-2.0/schemas/org.gtk.gtk4.Settings*.xml ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas/ && glib-compile-schemas ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas && mkdir -p ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Libs && cp ../../node-network/release/libnode_network.dylib ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Libs/libnode_network.dylib && dylibbundler -od -b -x ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/MacOS/nodeinnet-gtk -d ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Libs/ -p @executable_path/../Libs/ -s /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx -s /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/lib/swift-5.0/macosx -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.0/macosx -s /usr/lib/swift && ../../../src/fakelzo/build-macos.sh ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app/Contents/Libs/liblzo2.2.dylib && codesign --force --deep --sign - ./release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app
scripts.build-gtk-dmg: rm -f ./bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin/NodeInNet.dmg && npm run build-distr-osx && rm -rf ./bin/distr/dmg_stage && mkdir -p ./bin/distr/dmg_stage && cp -r ./bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin/release/bundle/osx/NodeInNet.app ./bin/distr/dmg_stage/ && create-dmg --volname "NodeInNet Installer" --window-pos 200 120 --window-size 800 400 --icon-size 100 --app-drop-link 600 185 "./bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin/NodeInNet.dmg" "./bin/distr/dmg_stage/" && rm -rf ./bin/distr/dmg_stage
scripts.licenses: cargo about generate --config about.toml about.hbs -o THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md
